title: The EU Code of Practice and future of AI in Europe
summary: OpenAI joins the EU Code of Practice, advancing responsible AI while partnering with European governments to drive innovation, infrastructure, and economic growth.
body: OpenAI joins the EU Code of Practice, advancing responsible AI while partnering with European governments to drive innovation, infrastructure, and economic growth.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布加入欧盟AI行为准则（EU Code of Practice），旨在通过与欧洲政府合作，推动负责任的AI创新、基础设施建设及经济增长。此举反映了大型模型公司在面对日益严格的欧洲监管环境时，正积极寻求通过合规化手段融入当地生态系统。
